scores.tell: Envelope has soft, broad form turn and gentle sheen, close to the real cards. The stamp edge is slightly crisp.
The cauldron is glossy purple plastic with a bright blob hot spot on the belly and the rim, like the statue-glossy lessons.
The binocular viewer has many sharp chrome hot spots and glassy lens reflections, so the metal reads hard and shiny.
Stone table and stools have soft, gentle shading with plausible shadows. The form turn is a bit flat and banded on the stool sides.
The helmet visor is a large glossy amber gradient with a sharp white glint, and the white shell is smooth plastic.
Soft, plush matte fabric with a gentle core shadow and a broad sheen, like the real towel. The buckles have small crisp glints.
Door and ivy are softly shaded with plausible light. The door panel is flat, and the knob and leaf highlights are slightly sharp.
Keyboard has smooth, broad sheen and a soft contact shadow. The red body edges have slightly crisp highlights.
Cooler is softly lit with a plausible cast shadow. The cans and ice have sharp spec hot spots, and the red body is a little glossy.
Drums have many hard gold and chrome highlights and glossy blue shells, so they read as shiny plastic.
